lines: Good evening. I’m Hannah Thibedeau, and this is your Palindrome News brief.

The Supreme Court of Canada has upheld Quebec’s secularism law and its use of the notwithstanding clause – as Saskatchewan waits to have its own case heard in the new year, The Canadian Press reports.
A First Nation in northern Manitoba has declared a state of emergency over what it says is unsafe drinking water.
iRestore’s Black Friday sale cuts up to 58% off LED face masks and hair growth helmets, with savings of up to $470 on select light therapy devices, Fox News reports.
Kenneth Law apologizes in court to victims’ families as Crown seeks 25-year sentence, The Canadian Press reports.
OpenAI sued Apple on Friday, accusing the Big Tech giant of stealing its trade secrets and blocking its access to hardware suppliers, Reuters reports.
That’s your brief. We’ll keep watching, so you don’t have to.
